notes: Restrictions here are those that bite beyond the numeric rating thresholds. A multi-territory release must satisfy the strictest applicable value on every dimension, which is the calculation writers targeting co-production currently perform by hand, if at all.

items.label: United States
items.regulator: Classification and Rating Administration (CARA), Motion Picture Association
citations: Motion Picture Association, Classification and Rating Rules

items.label: United Kingdom

additional_restrictions.description: Depiction that could function as instruction in drug preparation or use is cut at any classification below 18, independently of how the drug use is framed.
additional_restrictions.citation: British Board of Film Classification, Classification Guidelines — drugs

citations: British Board of Film Classification, Classification Guidelines

items.label: India

additional_restrictions.description: Depiction of violence against women receives specific scrutiny and is routinely cut or reclassified below the A certificate, even where the overall violence level would otherwise be permitted.
additional_restrictions.citation: Central Board of Film Certification, guidelines under the Cinematograph Act

additional_restrictions.description: Depiction that presents drug use as attractive or consequence-free attracts cuts at every classification, including A.
additional_restrictions.citation: Central Board of Film Certification, guidelines under the Cinematograph Act

additional_restrictions.description: Depicted sexual activity remains restricted at every classification, including the adult A certificate, more tightly than in comparable Western territories.
additional_restrictions.citation: Fizzymag (2024), Greenlight or Red Tape: Government Influence on Filmmaking

prohibited_elements: content denigrating a religious or social group
citations: Central Board of Film Certification, certification categories and guidelines
Fizzymag (2024), Greenlight or Red Tape: Government Influence on Filmmaking

items.label: Germany

additional_restrictions.description: Depiction that glorifies violence is prohibited under German law independently of classification, so extreme violence framed approvingly is not available even at FSK 18.
additional_restrictions.citation: German Criminal Code section 131, applied through FSK classification practice

prohibited_elements: unconstitutional organisation symbols outside permitted contexts
citations: Freiwillige Selbstkontrolle der Filmwirtschaft, age rating categories and criteria

items.label: Australia

additional_restrictions.description: Depiction that presents drug use as an incentive is restricted below R 18+ regardless of the overall drug depiction level.
additional_restrictions.citation: Australian Classification Board, Guidelines for the Classification of Films

prohibited_elements: depiction presenting drug use as an incentive
citations: Australian Classification Board, Guidelines for the Classification of Films
